descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B11 · P1 · 新

快速口述框里打完字，约 0.8 秒内刷新或关掉页面，最后几个字会丢，没有提示

票：TFA-92582 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S21 「在 800 ms 自动保存窗口内刷新或关掉标签页：最后几个字不丢（脚本化）」 Reload or close the tab within the 800 ms autosave window: the last words are not dropped (scripted)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 5；TFA-92582 step 5；TFA-92583 AC 4）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture; pad open with one empty box

When Fill the box with 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.' and call page.reload() with no wait; reopen the pad. Then replace the whole text with 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged. Call back at 5.', call page.close() at once, open context.newPage() on the Hospital list and open the pad

Then The box still holds the full text, or the app says plainly that the last words were not saved

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: after the reload the box holds 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.'; in the new tab it holds 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged. Call back at 5.' (U4: never silently dropped). A visible 'not saved' message instead is recorded for Daniela. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92582 ready for qa；TFA-92583 ready for qa

在快速口述框里打完字，如果一秒内刷新或关掉标签页，最后的文字会丢，而且没有任何提示。

Text typed into a Quick Dictation box is lost without warning if the physician reloads or closes the tab within about a second of typing.

依据：newspec-b, reproduced twice. After a reload the box is empty and the server row is ''. After closing the tab, only the older sentence is left. No 'not saved' message appears. Cause: useQuickDictation's 800 ms debounce, with no flush on unload and no device draft. Breaks TC-04 U4 'never silently dropped'. Only predicted in the TC-04 risks; not in the dev report or ledger.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本（PW (page.reload with no wait, page.close)） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S21

Reload or close the tab within the 800 ms autosave window: the last words are not dropped (scripted)

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa); TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec: fill the pad box, page.reload() with no wait, reopen pad, assert full text; replace text, page.close() at once, context.newPage() on /rounding, open pad, assert the longer text. A visible 'not saved' message is recorded instead of failing. — Scripted reload/close within the 800 ms autosave debounce is a plain Playwright action.

Detail:

Reproduced twice. Reload with no wait after typing 'Bed 12, daughter updated, plan unchanged.': on reopening the box is empty and the server row is ''. Replacing it with '... Call back at 5.' and closing the tab at once: the new tab shows only the old sentence. No 'not saved' message either time.

产品问题：A physician who types into a Quick Dictation box and reloads or closes the tab within ~0.8 s loses the last words with no warning: the box comes back empty (or without 'Call back at 5.'). Breaks TC-04 U4 ('boxes are never silently dropped'). On main the pad saves on an 800 ms debounce (useQuickDictation) with no flush on unload and no device draft.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
